problem: refreshSavedGrants ran before surface selection with no signal; neither refreshAccessToken nor exchangeGithubTokenForCopilot has a default timeout, and both providers were refreshed whatever the session used.
impact: On a network that drops packets silently, keryx shell -p for any provider could hang for good; a copilot grant (≈30 min tokens) put a network call in front of nearly every launch.
suggested_fix: Pass AbortSignal.timeout(5_000) and refresh only the provider the session uses.
evidence: src/commands/shell.ts refresh block before chooseShellSurface; src/lib/oauth/login.ts refreshSavedGrants loop.

class_scope.enumeration_method: Every caller of refreshSavedGrants / refreshProviderGrant (one production caller after this PR).

disposition.evidence: commit 5fbc78610dd14be87ddd22a7544de4774a4fa233: GRANT_REFRESH_TIMEOUT_MS = 5_000 via AbortSignal.timeout, providers limited to providerArg when given; sequential kept on purpose (each refresh rewrites auth.json)

verification.evidence: Verified the fix commit 5fbc78610dd14be87ddd22a7544de4774a4fa233. src/commands/shell-grant-refresh.test.ts asserts the refresh call passes AbortSignal.timeout(GRANT_REFRESH_TIMEOUT_MS) and runs before chooseShellSurface; refresh-saved-grants.test.ts shows a session on another provider never calls the grok token endpoint. 101 targeted tests and 731 terminal tests pass.

impact: After /provider and entering a key, shell_exec in the same session still passed that key to commands — the K-015 leak on one path.
evidence: tui-shell.ts picker key branch; the only other process.env writer from saved config.

disposition.evidence: commit 5fbc78610dd14be87ddd22a7544de4774a4fa233: noteSavedCredentialEnv([envKey]) at the picker write; test in src/harness/process/shell-env.test.ts

verification.evidence: Verified the fix commit 5fbc78610dd14be87ddd22a7544de4774a4fa233. shell-env.test.ts: a key recorded through noteSavedCredentialEnv — the call now made at the TUI picker write — is absent from resolveShellEnv's result.

problem: Readline provider detection saw saved keys only because the first shell_exec used to load them into process.env; removing that side effect changed what /provider lists.
impact: A provider configured only by a saved key disappeared from readline detection.
suggested_fix: Build the readline selector's env with envWithSavedApiKeys.

class_scope.enumeration_method: Both env reads in the readline selector.

disposition.evidence: commit 5fbc78610dd14be87ddd22a7544de4774a4fa233: realSelectProviderModel uses envWithSavedApiKeys(process.env) for detection and picking

problem: An expired grant with no refresh token is skipped silently: grantNeedsRefresh returns false without a refresh token.
impact: The same opaque 403 K-013 describes still follows for such a grant.
suggested_fix: Warn when expires <= now and there is no refresh token.

impact: Noise on every start for a provider the session does not use.
